layer_policy.F.Cu: critical/local signals, short analog front-end routes and local power loops
layer_policy.In2.Cu: power distribution and controlled low-impedance branches; no sensitive analog signal routing
layer_policy.B.Cu: secondary low-speed signals and long-haul control/telemetry where needed
layer_policy.z0_policy: Only shortest direct escapes to/from J_UNOQ pads may enter Z0; no production footprints, no switching loops and no actuator high-current routing in Z0.
layer_policy.rf_policy: Do not invent a numeric antenna keepout absent from Arduino primary source; final enclosure/stacking/RF copper review remains a release gate.

routing_classes.name: GND_REFERENCE
rules: In1.Cu remains continuous GND reference.
Local stitching vias may be added in routing phase without segmenting quiet and dirty return paths.

routing_classes.name: PWR_INPUT_5A
rules: Keep J_PWR_IN -> TVS/eFuse -> bulk loop inside Z3 and as short as placement permits.

routing_classes.name: PWR_12V_BRANCH
rules: 12V_ACT stays in Z3/Z4 except its source split and never traverses Z1/Z2.
12V_HOST_VIN is the only 12 V branch permitted to terminate at J_UNOQ VIN.

routing_classes.name: ACTUATOR_OUTPUT
rules: Remain confined to Z4.
Do not run parallel to sensitive analog nets.
Return current must close toward the Z3/Z4 star path, never through Z1/Z2.

routing_classes.name: PWR_5V
rules: Local shield rail only; never tie to J_UNOQ.5.

routing_classes.name: PWR_3V3
rules: Local shield rail only; never tie to J_UNOQ.4.

routing_classes.name: ANALOG_SENSITIVE
rules: Reference continuously to In1.Cu GND.
No parallel adjacency to PUMP_OUT1/PUMP_OUT2/CO2_SOL_POS/12V_ACT.
PUMP_CURRENT_ADC crosses from Z4 to Z0 through the quietest available corridor and must avoid Z3 switching/power-entry loops.
LOAD_A_POS/LOAD_A_NEG are routed as a coupled quiet pair from J_LOADCELL to U_HX; no actuator return between them.

routing_classes.name: FIELD_ANALOG_LOCAL
rules: Remain in Z1 and as short as possible between field connector, ESD/protection and conditioning.
Vias are strongly discouraged before the RC/ADC node.

routing_classes.name: CONTROL_SENSITIVE
rules: Keep feedback/programming loops local to their ICs.
Do not route adjacent to actuator outputs or power-entry current path.
TPSM33625 exposes no external SW net; a production net named SW is forbidden.

routing_classes.name: DIGITAL_LOW_SPEED
rules: Prefer B.Cu for long-haul low-speed routing so F.Cu remains available for local analog and power loops.
I2C and HX711 clocks remain away from analog front-end inputs.

routing_classes.name: CHILLER_DRY_CONTACT
rules: SELV <=48 V only; NO MAINS.
Remain confined to Z4 isolated contact side.
No intentional connection to GND or local logic rails.

cross_class_rules.dirty_return_policy: No high-current return path through Z1/Z2; close in Z3/Z4 toward the protected-input star split.
cross_class_rules.buck_policy: TPSM33625 input/output/feedback loops remain in Z3; no routing under/through Z1, HX711 or UNO Q RF region.
cross_class_rules.ground_policy: In1.Cu continuous GND reference; no signal tracks on In1.Cu.

next_gate: PR19 may materialize routing only after PR18 CI proves 59/59 net coverage, zero duplicate class assignments, frozen geometry/placement, and tracks/vias/zones remain zero in PR18.
